text:
Want to improve your SEO? Open Google Search Console. It's free.

The Performance report lists the searches people typed before they saw your website.

Pick one that matches a job you want more of. "Hot water repair Morley."

Give that job its own page on your website.

Picture a painter in Fremantle who wants better SEO.

He's about to spend AUD$6,000 on a new website.

His Google profile still shows his old phone number.

Fix the free stuff first. Right phone number, real hours, a review after every job.

Then think about the website.

Just opened your business? Get your Google Business Profile verified this week.

Google picks how you verify. If it offers a video call, take it. Google's help page recommends it.

On the call, show the van with your name on the side. A real business with real tools.
